inherited_reader.mass_field: st.rho summed over the cells returned by domc_core.read_sites
inherited_reader.membership: DYNAMICALLY REDETECTED at every scored time by the frozen detector (threshold 0.30, min_cells 12), NOT immutable t0 masks
inherited_reader.split_merge_disappear: if either A or B is unreadable the unit is undefined and the stage is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; no imputation

endpoint.a: abs(m_A - m_B) / (m_A + m_B), requires m_A>=0, m_B>=0, S>0
endpoint.quadrature: trapezoidal in PHYSICAL time, normalised so sum_h w_h = 1

S1_CONSERVATIVE_CARRIER_REDISTRIBUTION.algebra: raw-byte transposition of Mf[0] on the frozen maximum-support lexicographic cross-component matching; exactly content-conserving, byte-involutive

S2_NONCONSERVATIVE_CARRIER_TRANSFORMATIO.algebra: carrier transformations that do NOT conserve the carrier content or its multiset: lattice reflection of the intensive field, lattice reflection of the extensive field, and total ablation. Cousins, not three superfamilies.

S3_ENVIRONMENTAL_FIELD_PERTURBATION.algebra: additive perturbation of the public nutrient field N; touches no carrier
S3_ENVIRONMENTAL_FIELD_PERTURBATION.note: LOCKED. Not executed in qualification. Q2 explicitly forbids the material signal from being carried only by this arm, so it is the one held out.

locked_dev_evaluation: NOT YET CREATED; no founder and no outcome exists

gates.Q2: A_bu > ETA_b for >=2 TRAIN superfamilies in >=3 founders
gates.Q3: sigma_2/sigma_1 > 0.10 on the weighted response matrix
gates.Q4: median LOFO unexplained fraction >= 0.25 and every fold >= 0.10
gates.Q5: L_STATE <= 0.90 * L_NUIS in median grouped LOFO
gates.membership_dominance: stop if >50% of quadrature-weighted response energy is attributable to membership change
